We aim to foster a more transparent, collaborative and productive IP / Innovation Eco-system for India

Today, SpicyIP has almost become a one stop shop for all things relating to Indian intellectual property and innovation law and policy:
·       It carries analytical posts on complex issues of IP and innovation law and policy
·       It carries shorter newsy blog posts that attempt to bring the reader the most pertinent IP news from India and around the world.
·       It lists important IP events in the country and around the world, including IP conferences, workshops etc.
·       It conducts polls to gauge the views of the public on important IP issues
·       It campaigns for more transparency in Indian intellectual property institutions (such as the Indian Patent Office) by spearheading online petitions that are then submitted to the government

Through its independent and objective reporting, SpicyIP aims to further the cause of transparency as well, as reflected it its mission statement: “We aim to increase transparency in Indian intellectual property policy/institutions. We also stand for fair, objective and accurate reporting/review of intellectual property and innovation policy news from India. ”

Name: Nabhah Foundation
Description:
NABHAH is a non profit space exploration company, established under the CSR support of Indian Golf Premier League (IGPL), an initiative of Bharat Golf Pvt Ltd of Focal Ventures, Hyderabad. It is focused on enhancing Indian national capacity for tracking, understanding and mitigating the risks of debris in the Low Earth Orbit (LEO) of space. 
WHAT are the main goals of NABHAH?
There are two fundamental goals. (1) Enhancing India’s capacity to detect, track and record the space debris and detrimental space objects and (2) Enhancing the general capacity of detecting space objects that are smaller than 10 cm in size, which now appears to be a technology barrier. The current status is that there are millions of debris objects in LEO whereas, we are only able to track just about 2 to 3% of them. And most of these objects are under 10 cm in size, but have the
potential to strike at a speed of 10km/sec and completely obliterate satellite missions.
HOW will this be done?
NABHAH aspires to build national, corporate and possibly international convergence of tracking capacity through cooperation, collaboration and research in the fields of radar and optical telescope technologies. It aspires to install critical infrastructure on the ground and on moving ships. NABHAH
also plans to build dedicated satellite missions as well satellite sensors including improvised star trackers to track space debris.

IPFonline Ltd has promoted and owns www.ipfonline.com, www.indiantextilejournal.com and www.automotiveproductsfinder.com. Industrial Products Finder was visualised and conceived as an industrial new-products-news monthly by R. V. Pandit, and was launched as such in October 1972. Right from the first issue, more than 38 years ago, the magazine contained unique features. It showcased exactly what the name of the magazine proclaimed: Industrial Products Finder. It carries only advertisements on industrial products, which is awaited news in industry circles.
The magazine, being industry-centric in nature, is made available only through prepaid annual (1-year and 3-year, and 5-year) subscriptions to businesses, industries and technical/managerial personnel, so as to avoid wastage. All of the above continues to be so even today.
Yet, there have been dramatic changes. Over the years, the magazine has grown in size and reach. It is so popular that it is simply known as IPF in industrial circles. It is so useful to readers that anybody in industry who gets to examine it becomes its subscriber. As a standing testimony to its reputation, thousands of subscribers (both companies and individuals alike) who initially subscribed to the early issues of IPF from 1972 are still its subscribers even today.

Accessibility is at the heart of everything we build. Our goal is to remove communication barriers and empower people to express their thoughts, needs, emotions, and ideas in everyday life.

Whether at home, in school, at work, or in healthcare settings, Voxetu helps create more inclusive conversations and greater independence.

We believe every person deserves the opportunity to be heard, understood, and connected.

**Our Vision**
To create a world where communication is accessible to everyone through innovative, inclusive, and AI-powered technology.

**Our Mission**
To empower people with communication challenges by delivering reliable, intuitive, and accessible AAC solutions that improve independence, participation, and quality of life.

Our platform categorizes companies into structured layers ranging from service-based firms and startups to top product companies ensuring that access, pricing, and demand are intelligently balanced. At its core, Reffconnect is not just a hiring tool it is building a referral economy where access to opportunities is no longer limited by who you know, but enabled by a fair, transparent, and incentive-driven system.

Our mission is simple:
To make hiring faster, more accessible, and merit-driven by unlocking the power of structured referrals at scale.

Description:
Maalexi is building the foundational infrastructure for real-world asset (RWA) exchange in global agricultural trade — engineered from physical execution, not abstraction. This is not a layer on broken systems; it is the replacement for them. 

The problem is structural: SMEs that produce and move the majority of the world’s food cannot access financing because no bank can reliably verify their inventory, contracts, or counterparties. Maalexi solves this by transforming fragmented commodity flows into transparent, auditable, and finance-ready trade assets. 

The platform combines AI-driven trade intelligence, IoT-based asset monitoring, and blockchain-enforced settlement to verify commodities across storage and transit, dynamically price risk, score counterparties, and execute legally binding contracts in real time. 

The system is already live, with real transactions, verified inventory, and operational warehousing across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Europe, and India. On-chain settlement finality is being advnaced on Avalanche blockchain, making every trade transparent, auditable, and settlement-final. 

Maalexi’s key goal is to deliver MAATEX, the world’s first regulated public RWA agricultural exchange, where tokenized agricultural commodities trade fast, in a derisked environment with instant settlement like the regulated and public commodity exchanges, backed by verified physical assets.

Name: TiNT
Description:
TiNT brings tech ed and opportunities to therapists, and clinical credibility to mental health products.

Our premise is this: mental health practitioners are systematically left out of the rooms where the tools meant to serve their field get built. That absence cuts both ways. For the industry, it means products built without the clinical judgment that makes them trustworthy, showing up as low adoption, low retention, and high churn. For therapists, it means no real stake in an industry that's reshaping their profession around them, and no sustainable income beyond service hours, without which they burn out and leave the field, worsening the exact access gap those tools were supposed to fix.

TiNT exists to close both gaps at once: bring therapists into mental health innovation, and give them fair, reliable income from it.

TiNT Academy runs the flagship course Applied Product Thinking for Therapists, a hands-on program that teaches practicing clinicians to think like builders and how to engage with the tools showing up in mental healthcare as users, evaluators, collaborators, and critics, and not just downstream recipients. The Academy also prepares therapists to evolve their practice for a changing clinical landscape, including how to recognize and respond to clients' AI-related issues, and building AI psychoeducation into everyday clinical work.

TiNT Studio is the consulting arm. We place therapists directly inside startups, through recruiting or short-term projects, so founders and technologists get structured clinical perspective, and therapists get paid work that isn't more service hours.

Working both sides of the ecosystem means TiNT gets therapists and builders speaking the same language, and gives clinicians a strong stake, income, and voice, in how mental health technology gets shaped.

Description:
It all started when I visited my grandfather and stumbled on an old box full of silver turned brown coins. 

What could be more fascinating to a nine-year-old kid than finding coins with photos of different people?

 Always an artsy, I started collecting the coins with different photos, naive with the idea of what those pictures might mean. 

You would laugh when I share that I in fact threw some coins that had similar pictures. I am not even sure now at the age of 24 what those coins might be worth. I would literally snatch every coin from anybody and everybody I could see a new face on. 

This childhood fascination grew into a serious hobby! 

I do not belong to the privileged class of family to buy the coins and notes that were important to me. Most of my collection is the gift of my ancestors, courtesy of my friends who visited foreign lands and the now earning me, who could exchange some valuables that I have with the valuables of others.

I saw my cousins growing up buying coins and notes they wanted but I did not know how to connect, how to share my collection, where to look for other collectors and the least to even understand how this entire thing works. Even if I stumble on a facebook connection who does seem credible, how do I make sure it is?

That is when I envisioned creating a social media platform where anyone and everyone no matter what stage or expertize can engage with this larger numismatics community and learn and help each other grow. Why should this hobby be the privilege of the elite members? Why not make a platform as easy to navigate as Facebook and as easy to perform business operations as a phone call?

We aim to build a single platform that serves to educate, showcase, exchange and, build business relationships while ensuring high security and strict members verification to eliminate fraud.

Name: Non Malignant
Description:
Cancer shouldn't get a head start.

Non Malignant exists to fight one of cancer's most consequential problems: late detection.

Too often, people begin thinking seriously about cancer only after symptoms appear, someone close to them is diagnosed, or a routine examination raises a concern.

We believe the conversation should begin earlier.

Through cancer education, research, expert-led conversations, community initiatives and the development of early-detection solutions, we're working to help people understand cancer risk and appropriate screening before that information becomes urgent.

Our work is built around three beliefs:

Don't wait for symptoms to start learning.
Cancer awareness should begin before someone has a reason to fear cancer.

Know your risk before you need to.
Age, family history, genetics and other risk factors can influence the conversations people should have with qualified healthcare professionals.

Earlier action can create more options.
When clinically possible, detecting cancer earlier can materially change the choices available to patients and clinicians.

Non Malignant began with a deeply personal experience of late-stage breast cancer within our founding team. That experience turned one question into our mission:

What would healthcare look like if more people had the knowledge and tools to act earlier?

Today, we're working across awareness, research, community and technology toward that goal.

We don't believe every late diagnosis can be prevented. Some cancers remain difficult to detect early, effective screening is not available for every cancer, and access to healthcare remains a major barrier.

But wherever earlier action is possible, we believe people should have the knowledge to take it.

Late detection steals options.

Cancer shouldn't get a head start.

Name: Freelancer
Description:
A freelancer or freelance worker is a term commonly used for a person who is self-employed and is not necessarily committed to a particular employer long-term. Freelance workers are sometimes represented by a company or a temporary agency that resells freelance labor to clients; others work independently or use professional associations or websites to get work.

While the term "independent contractor" would be used in a higher register of English to designate the tax and employment class of this type of worker, the term freelancing is most common in culture and creative industries and this term specifically motions to participation therein.

Fields, professions and industries where freelancing is predominant include music, writing, acting, computer programming, web design, translating and illustrating, and other forms of piece work which some cultural theorists consider as central to the cognitive-cultural economy.

Our vision is simple: business owners should focus on serving customers and growing their business—not chasing payments. Name: GDNet

GDNet is a knowledge hub that brings together and communicates policy-relevant research from the Global South. It aims to  be an internationally recognized focal point/ knowledge broker for development research to inform policy debate. GDNet is a partnership with regional networks and leading experts in the field. GDNet provides access to on-line journals and data, synthesizes and communicates Southern research, and strengthens research communications capacity.

GDNet’s activities are all been underpinned by the belief that good research leads to better policy-making and that policy processes concerning global development are better informed by outstanding research from the South. All GDNet consolidated efforts continue to promote southern research communications and uptake by strengthening research communications capacity, sharing knowledge and supporting learning.

जय श्री सनातन धर्म और भागवत गीता के माध्यम से हम भारतीय संस्कृति और ज्ञान को समझते हैं। सनातन धर्म, जिसे हिंदू धर्म भी कहा जाता है, विश्व के एक प्राचीन और सर्वाधिक विशाल धर्मों में से एक है। भागवत गीता, यह महाभारत का एक अद्भुत अध्याय है, जिसमें भगवान श्रीकृष्ण ने अर्जुन को अपने कर्तव्य के महत्व को समझाने के लिए उपदेश दिया था। भगवत गीता में विभिन्न धर्मिक तत्त्वों, ज्ञान, योग, भक्ति, और वैष्णव तत्त्वों की बातें हैं जो हमें एक योग्य और सफल जीवन जीने के लिए मार्गदर्शन करती हैं।

वसुधैव कुटुंबकम, यह संस्कृत श्लोक है जिसका अर्थ होता है "सम्पूर्ण विश्व एक परिवार है"। भारतीय संस्कृति में हमें सिखाया जाता है कि सभी मनुष्य भाई-बहन के रूप में एक-दूसरे के साथ व्यवहार करें और सभी को प्रेम और सम्मान से देखें। यह सोच विश्वास करती है कि समस्त मानवता एक परिवार के सदस्य है और हम सभी को एक-दूसरे के साथ उदार भाव से रहना चाहिए।

भारत, अपनी विविधता और समृद्धि के लिए जाना जाता है। यह देश भूगोल, भाषा, धर्म, संस्कृति और जीवन-शैली में विशालता के लिए प्रसिद्ध है। भारतीय संस्कृति में शिक्षण को बहुत महत्व दिया जाता है। भारतीय शिक्षा पद्धति में असीमित ज्ञान का महत्व है।

वेदों, उपनिषदों, और पुराणों जैसे प्राचीन धार्मिक ग्रंथों के माध्यम से ज्ञान की विस्तृत जानकारी दी जाती है। वेद भारतीय संस्कृति के प्राचीनतम ग्रंथ हैं, जो विभिन्न विषयों में ज्ञान के स्रोत के रूप में जाने जाते हैं। उपनिषद्यों में दिव्य ज्ञान, आध्यात्मिकता, और ब्रह्म विचार के सूक्ष्मतम पहलुओं की चर्चा होती है। पुराणों में धार्मिक कथाएं, इतिहास, और ज्ञान के साथ-साथ मनोरंजन भी होता है।

भारतीय शिक्षा पद्धति में गुरु-शिष्य परंपरा को महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है। गुरु शिक्षार्थी को ज्ञान के अनमोल रत्नों से परिचय कराता है और उसे धार्मिक और आध्यात्मिक मूल्यों का संस्कार करता है। यह शिक्षा पद्धति आज भी भारतीय संस्कृति में महत्वपूर्ण है और इसका प्रचार-प्रसार विभिन्न शिक्षा संस्थानों और आश्रमों में किया जाता है।

Name: Hyriki
Description:
We've spent most of our professional lives in classrooms, boardrooms, training rooms, and far too many hiring meetings. Between us, that adds up to years in education, assessments, teacher training, school leadership, and education technology. Long enough to notice a pattern.

Schools care deeply about hiring the right educators. Yet hiring decisions are often made using CVs, referrals, gut feel, and hurried interviews — not because schools don't want better systems, but because better systems rarely exist.

We saw the gap clearly: education was becoming more data-driven everywhere except where it mattered most — hiring the people who shape classrooms every day.

Somewhere between building education products, working closely with schools, and debating hiring decisions over endless cups of coffee, we realised two things. First, this problem wasn't small. Second, it wasn't going to fix itself.

We met through our shared work in education and technology, bonded over a healthy frustration with broken hiring processes, and quickly agreed on one thing — if capability can be measured, it should be measured fairly, consistently, and at scale.

So we stopped complaining and started building.

Hyriki was born to bring structure, objectivity, and confidence to educator hiring — using data and technology not to replace human judgement, but to strengthen it.

We're still driven by the same belief that started it all: better hiring leads to better classrooms, and better classrooms change lives.

Description:
ILLUME by Luxury Tribe is an immersive knowledge and experience forum for the luxury travel trade — a place where a destination is not presented, but properly understood.

The way the luxury trade learns a destination has not kept pace with the way the luxury traveller experiences one. It is also a meeting of peers. The buyers in the room are among the most considered in the Indian market; the destinations and brands hosted are chosen with the same care. What emerges is a sharper reading of the luxury market itself, built in the company of people who shape it.

That sharper reading also takes published form. Each year, ILLUME releases a trend report drawn from the forum's conversations, observations, and signals — Next Frontier: India's Luxury Travel Trends 2025, followed by the 2026 study on the personas redefining India's luxury traveller. Description:
About Propcop

PropCop is a cloud hosted secure online data repository of public notices pertaining to immovable properties, published in daily newspapers across major cities of Gujarat and Mumbai. Our objective is to assist lenders & ARCs in protecting their security interests in mortgaged properties. 

All that we do is designed around the principles of PREVENT, PROTECT, DETECT.

PREVENT – Pre disbursement

Weed out collateral properties that have unacceptable public notice history (for e.g. if the property is subject of an ongoing litigation, dispute or acquisition), even before incurring the cost of legal due diligence and property valuation.

Name: Legalex Services LLP
Description:
Legalex is practice management software for law firms. It brings matters, documents, timekeeping, billing, and client communication together so your team works from one place.

What Legalex is made for
Legalex is built for law firms that want a clean system of record and a simple daily workflow. If your team moves between matters in different practice areas and needs one place to track tasks, documents, time, billing and client updates, Legalex will feel natural. Partners can see progress and profitability, associates can focus on the work in front of them, and your admin team can invoice and reconcile without chasing data across tools.

The day to day flow
Most days start with the firm dashboard. Upcoming hearings, filing deadlines, tasks and matter updates are listed in one view. From there users drill into a matter to review documents, add notes, log time or send a client update. Timekeepers can run a timer while they write or review, then submit entries for approval. At the end of the week your billing team generates draft invoices, routes them for partner review and sends clean, itemized bills to clients. The client portal shows status and invoices, which cuts the back and forth over email.

Matters and workflows
Every matter holds its own timeline, contacts, tasks, documents and financials. You can assign owners and roles, set key dates and create checklists for common matter types. Templates help you stand up a new matter with the right tasks in seconds. Tasks show who is responsible and what is due next, which means fewer surprises. Notes and comments keep conversation close to the work so you are not searching through long email threads.

Calendar and tasks
Deadlines matter in legal work. Legalex lets you map court dates, hearings, client meetings and internal reviews to a shared calendar. Tasks sync with the calendar so everyone can see the real timeline. You can filter by practice area, matter owner or location, then subscribe from Outlook or Google Calen

Schedule and flight operations lifecycle management

Crew planning, pairing, rostering, and operational control

OCC workflows for real-time decision-making

Built-in compliance and rule enforcement aligned with airline policies

Distribution is the backbone of Indian market. It facilitates flow of products from factory gate to consumer. Reaching consumers' doorstep in a large country like India is a challenge. Name: Jeevanee
Description:
Jeevanee is an AI-powered life assistant designed to help people make better decisions every day.

In today’s world, most people are not failing because they are lazy or unmotivated. They are overwhelmed. Too many choices, too much information, and constant pressure slowly drain mental energy. Over time, this leads to poor decisions, burnout, and loss of direction.

Jeevanee exists to solve this problem in a calm and practical way.

Instead of telling people what to do, Jeevanee helps them understand their day better:
• What truly matters today
• Where time and energy are actually going
• What tradeoffs a decision creates
• Why certain habits repeat again and again

Jeevanee looks at real life — tasks, routines, health signals, energy levels, and personal goals — and then offers clear suggestions and gentle guidance, not commands.

The person always stays in control.

There are no streaks, no guilt, and no pressure to be perfect. Missed days are normal. Bad days are expected. Jeevanee focuses on helping people reset, reflect, and move forward — not judge themselves.

The purpose is simple:
Not to do more things,
but to do the right things, with awareness.

We believe AI should not replace human thinking.
AI should support and strengthen human judgment.

Jeevanee is being built for everyday people — professionals, families, students, and anyone who wants structure without stress, discipline without fear, and technology that genuinely supports a better life.

Jeevanee is not about productivity.
It is about clarity, balance, and better decisions — one day at a time.

You are welcomed to review, comment, share information and maybe add the products/service you feel should be here, to add to the collective knowledge of the Community.

Each assessment is mapped to clauses, controls, and domains, enabling organizations to identify gaps, measure maturity, and prioritize actions with clarity and confidence.

ISAT PRO is designed for start-ups, growing organizations, and enterprises alike—whether you are preparing for your first certification, responding to customer security questionnaires, or strengthening governance and risk management. The platform converts assessment outcomes into clear insights, maturity scoring, and actionable recommendations, eliminating ambiguity and guesswork.

Our product team continuously updates questionnaires to reflect evolving threats, regulatory changes, and global audit expectations, ensuring relevance in a fast-changing security landscape.

At its core, ISAT PRO exists to simplify compliance readiness, reduce audit surprises, and empower informed security decisions—without unnecessary complexity.

Assess smarter. Prepare better. Comply with confidence.

Description:
Database administration refers to the entire activities performed by a database administrator to ensure that a database is made readily available when needed. It entails the function of maintaining and managing the database management systems. 
The role of database administration is usually dedicated to the IT department for a big firm, while small firms that cannot afford the cost of setting up a full-time database administration department engage the services of IT firms to handle their database administration. 
The primary importance of database administration is to ensure that there is sufficient up time for the database, so that the database can always be made available especially when needed. Ensuring the database is made available when needed, will involve taking proactive periods of monitoring and troubleshooting. 
The responsibility of database administration involves installing and configuring database servers and other related products, evaluating the features of a database, maintain a sound recovery policies and backup procedures for the recovery of data, taking maximum care of the implementation and database design, maintaining and implement database security roles, maintaining and setting up standards and documentation, monitoring performance and application tuning.
The personnel and skill that would be required to manage a database is dependent on the level of automation of the database. A database with a very minimal automation would require some reasonable significant experience resources to effective management. An organization may want to automate some significant amount of its work that can be done manually to reduce the skill that would be required to perform the task. Name: Nisha Kaushik
Description:
"Way to live life!" is a blog about how to live life With No Regrets. Like,
1. Let your loved ones know you love them.
The experience of love is one of the best things in life. When you love someone, let both your words and deeds be loving. 
2. Keep your work at work.
Earning a living is important, but not to the exclusion of other things. To fully participate in all aspects of life, such as spending time with loved ones and enjoying meaningful activities, we should leave work at work. 
3. Take life less seriously.
Life is far too short to be spent worrying about things that are beyond our control. Allow happiness and fun to be part of your life each day. Being mindful and open to the good that is present in all situations can help us not to take life so seriously and is a key ingredient to having a more enjoyable life.
4. Practice forgiveness.
At some point in life, we all have been hurt. How we deal with that hurt is up to us. Some people stay stuck in bitterness their entire lives and never move beyond the pain. By choosing to forgive, we release ourselves from the grip of resentment and can move forward in our lives.
5. Be yourself.
We hear this statement all the time, but it is the truth. We have our own values, beliefs, personality traits, and desires. When we deny any part of our authentic self, we die a little death on the inside. Our uniqueness makes us who we are. 
6. Practice kindness.	
Intentional kindness is life-giving. It works wonders in putting people at ease and improving relationships. Being kind is an easy practice that enhances our own lives and the lives of others, whether we know them or not.
Our lives are meant to be lived fully and completely, without regret. We never know how long we have, so let’s start living a life free of regrets today and every day.

Name: Track My Bus
Description:
The Vision

Track My Bus (TMB) is an end-to-end IoT solution dedicated to closing the critical digital gap in public transportation. We are transforming the daily commute by bringing reliable, real-time GPS tracking to the most essential transit options local seating and sleeper buses.

The Problem We Solved

Our journey began in early 2025 when we realized a stark reality: while trains and luxury coaches are easily trackable, the lifeline of daily travel the normal, affordable bus remains in a digital blind spot.
Commuters waste time, miss faster options, and non-local travelers are forced into expensive and limited choices. We decided that this lack of reliable, real-time information was unacceptable.

The Execution: From Prototype to Live System

TMB is not just an app; it's a full-stack, integrated system built from the ground up:

Custom Hardware: We designed and refined a compact, durable GPS tracking device that can be easily installed on any bus proving the core idea’s real-world viability.

Robust Backend: We built a high-performance cloud server using Python/Flask to decode complex GPS protocols (like Concox) and deliver live data instantly to the cloud (Firebase/DigitalOcean VPS).

Our system is engineered for mass adoption, ensuring accurate live location and Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) for every passenger.

Current Status & Next Steps

The core technology hardware, server pipeline, and data flow is fully developed and tested.
We’re now working closely with bus operators and have received a strong positive response to our plug-and-play solution.

Currently, we’re in the final development phase of our consumer mobile application, preparing to launch and redefine public mobility.

Name: Practiso Incorporation
Description:
Practiso is an Advocate Office Management Application.

At Practiso, we know how hard-working and time-consuming job it is for Advocates who practices law in various courts of India. From taking up any case to its final conclusion, an Advocate has to manage on various things like preparing for the case, working on its arguments, preparing notes and what not! Plus, it’s not just one case that an Advocate handles.

To manage number of cases, an Advocate has to maintain a Case Diary wherein he notes down all his cases and all the cases are forwarded to the next scheduled hearing date. For forwarding all the cases, one has to rewrite the case name, court name, judge name and other related blanks again and again on a daily basis.

Practiso makes this work way simpler. Long gone are the days when Advocates used to manually enter the proceeding details of the cases and used to stumble upon the pages of the diary to find the exact case, date and its notes. We bring you a digital way to manage your diary which helps Advocates to enter their case proceedings easily and search for the cases and dates with just one click.

By using Practiso, one will not have to make the entries of the case again and again on their scheduled date. The only thing you have to do is to just select the next date for the case and the app will do it all for you.

Practiso also lets you make Groups and add users in the Group. Suppose there are multiple Advocates in the same firm, the Administrator can create a Group and can add Advocates to the Group.

Practiso also has a capability of synchronizing all the data amongst its Users in the Group. Data like Adding New Case, Name of the Parties, taking up a Next Hearing Date etc. will be automatically shared amongst its users in the Group. This notifies to the other Advocates that a particular case has been attended and thus will avoid repetition.
